sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.3906 Of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/Accused Nos. 1 & 2 under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in Crime No.240 of 2020 pending on the file of Railway Koduru Police Station, YSR Kadapa District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 273 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short "I.P.C."), Section 5 of Cigarettes and Tobacco Products Act, 2003 and Section 50(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.

entities.text: Railway Koduru Police Station, YSR Kadapa District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh, this criminal petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.

The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.
__________________________________________ JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Date: 21.09.2020 SP Therla Narasimha Prasad vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 21 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44182077/
